scope: All current and future Bedrijfsgeheugen capabilities, agents, workflows, channels, data, intelligence, content, sales, revenue, analytics, learning and delivery components.
required_preflight: Read current canonical state, shared team context, open obligations and relevant prior learnings before designing or changing anything.
Identify the existing canonical owner, data route, queue, graph, publisher, analytics route and learning route for the capability.
Reuse or extend existing components before creating anything new.
Create a new component only when the capability demonstrably does not already exist and register it in the existing Powerhouse architecture.
prohibitions: Do not create a parallel Brain, CRM, truth store, database, queue, calendar, analytics store, learning system, content brain or sales system when an existing canonical capability can be reused or extended.
Do not treat a new request as a standalone subsystem by default.
Do not declare done on implementation evidence alone.
integration_rule: Every relevant change must integrate with the existing Powerhouse chain and, where applicable, the Brain, Supabase canonical data, intelligence, relationship graph, content, sales, revenue outcomes and learning/calibration loop.
canonical_shorthand: Voeg dit canoniek toe aan het Powerhouse, reuse-first, volledig geïntegreerd en closed-loop. Geen parallel onderdeel.
shorthand_semantics: Read existing state first, reuse canonical components, integrate end-to-end, verify production outcome, write learning back, and never create a parallel subsystem unless explicitly required by proven capability absence.
prevention: Every agent/chat must treat Bedrijfsgeheugen Powerhouse as the single overkoepelende operating system and must extend that system rather than rebuilding isolated capabilities.
